findings.title: All 12 success criteria from the slice design are covered
findings.description: Every Success Criterion (1-12) has corresponding task coverage. SC1 → Tasks 1.1, 1.2, 8.5; SC2 → Tasks 5.1, 5.3, 8.1; SC3 → Tasks 3.2, 3.3, 4.1; SC4 → Task 4.1 (dropped-topics rule); SC5 → Tasks 5.1, 8.2; SC6 → Task 6.1, 8.4; SC7 → Tasks 6.1, 8.3; SC8 → Tasks 6.2, 8.4; SC9 → Tasks 7.2, 8.1; SC10 → Tasks 7.1, 7.3; SC11 → Tasks 3.1, 8.6; SC12 → Task 8.1.

findings.title: Task sequencing respects dependencies with no circular references
findings.description: Sequence is 0 (branch/premise) → 1 (selector) → 2 (preconditions) → 3 (sources) → 4 (mapping) → 5 (interview) → 6 (write contract) → 7 (governance/output) → 8 (walkthrough) → 9 (close). Each step depends on prior tasks and the linear flow is correct.

findings.title: Test-with pattern is followed consistently
findings.description: Every implementation task (1.1, 2.1, 3.1-3.3, 4.1, 5.1-5.2, 6.1-6.2, 7.1-7.3) is followed by an explicit verification subtask (1.2, 2.2, 3.4, 4.2, 5.3, 6.3, 7.4) that diffs or executes against the design. Task 8 is the end-to-end walkthrough that exercises the whole flow.

findings.title: Commit markers are placed at working, tested points; none are checkboxes
findings.description: Plain-line `**Commit**:` markers appear at the end of verification subtasks (1.2, 2.2, 3.4, 4.2, 5.3, 6.3, 7.4, 8.6, 9.3) — none use checkbox syntax and none follow every single task. No markers on intermediate authoring steps within a task.

findings.title: Proportionality fits the slice scope
findings.description: 9 tasks for a slice whose only non-document change is `commands/analysis/understand.md` plus one generated concept is proportionate. Tasks are not oversized (highest effort 3/5) and verification subtasks are appropriately scoped (1/5 each). No test tasks beyond what the success criteria require.

findings.title: Walkthrough exercises the three PM-facing outcomes
findings.description: Task 8.1 (happy path with PM correction) exercises the extracted-and-corrected outcome; Task 8.2 (decline path on scratch copy) exercises declined; Task 8.3 (contract failure on scratch guide) exercises loud stop; Task 8.4 covers re-run/augment. This covers every SC outcome the design lists without redundantly testing covered paths.

findings.title: No scope creep detected
findings.description: No tasks address excluded territory (no Python, no changes to `src/squadron/`, no Preflight Graph Contract edits, no frontmatter gate changes, no `guide.ai-project.000-concept.md` changes, no docs/ mining). Task 7.4 is the only edit to a previously written file (comprehension flow text), explicitly authorized by the design's Implementation Notes.

findings.title: PM interaction framing is captured before the live walkthrough
findings.description: The PM interaction notice at the top of the file plus the inline reminder before Task 8.1 ensure the agent does not fire the two engagement questions without framing. This matches the project's "never fire questions without framing" rule. Informational, not a finding.

Walkthrough exercises the three PM-facing outcomes
PM interaction framing is captured before the live walkthrough
